# Open data harbor

Flat export of the Dolly Legacy moments database — the file you link when pitching open data.

| File | License | Live URL |
|------|---------|----------|
| [moments.json](./moments.json) | [CC BY 4.0](../src/content/LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt) | https://www.dollyparton.page/data/moments.json |

**Do not edit this copy by hand.** The source of truth is [`src/content/moments.json`](../src/content/moments.json). Run `npm run sync-data` (also runs before `npm run build`) to refresh the export.

Schema: [`src/content/moments.schema.json`](../src/content/moments.schema.json)
